items.author: CoinDesk
items.context: CoinDesk: BTC cae bajo US$60.000, su nivel más bajo desde julio y 52% bajo su máximo histórico (con gráfico). Contexto del momento: más de US$1.000 millones liquidados en 24 h según CoinGlass (Cointelegraph).
items.suggested_text:
A 52% drawdown sounds brutal until you set it against Bitcoin's own history. The 2011 cycle bottomed at -92.7% and took 622 days to reclaim its high; the 2013 cycle fell 84.5% and needed 1,177 days. The depth has tended to shrink cycle by cycle as the holder base widens, while flushes like today's $1B+ in liquidations clear out leverage in hours.

The headline percentage matters less than who is doing the selling. Forced sellers on leverage disappear quickly; long-term holders capitulating is a different story, and historically that's what has set how long the recovery clock runs.
